_note: Tier 2 batch w07, 29 November to 3 December 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Banks trading with XRP, which he says is what is being reported.
mentions.quote: banks concerning XRP and trading with XRP
mentions.falsify_match: Major banks settle or trade in that asset.

mentions.claim_text: Bank of America recommending wealth management clients allocate up to four percent of portfolios to crypto assets.
mentions.quote: allocate up to 4% of their portfolios to crypto
mentions.falsify_match: The recommendation is issued as reported.

mentions.claim_text: Macron will come out pushing war while Trump says he wants peace, framed as the Ishmael against the Isaac.
mentions.quote: you're going to see Mcronone come out and they'll push war
mentions.falsify_match: A public split with France pushing escalation and Washington pushing settlement.

mentions.claim_text: A prayer assignment following the meeting with Macron and the Ukrainian president.
mentions.quote: after he has the meeting today with I mean yesterday
mentions.falsify_match: A decision emerging from that meeting.

mentions.claim_text: The next stage is a black swan event, which they are shown in part in order to pray against.
mentions.quote: the next stage is a black swan event
mentions.falsify_match: An unforeseen shock follows.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over Israel with the word regrouping heard, and asking that the president be given greater discernment.
mentions.quote: I heard the word regrouping. Regrouping
mentions.falsify_match: A renewed round of conflict after the regrouping.

mentions.claim_text: Trump calls the man a great leader, but he says the man is evil, a liar and two-faced.
mentions.quote: I told you he was very evil and he was a liar
mentions.falsify_match: The figure turns on the president.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the man is two-faced and evil and that the president needs to watch out for him.
mentions.quote: this guy is two-faced and he's an evil man
mentions.falsify_match: A betrayal by the named figure.

mentions.claim_text: The Holy Spirit said to watch Venezuela in the days ahead, seen again while praying.
mentions.quote: in the days ahead to watch Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Venezuela becomes a central story.

mentions.claim_text: He is removed like Gaddafi and Saddam Hussein and a proxy government is installed, after which great revival breaks out in Venezuela.
mentions.quote: they would put in a proxy government
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change followed by a reported revival.

mentions.claim_text: Nothing stands against the dollar, so he must go, which he offers as the reason for the whole operation.
mentions.quote: nothing stands against the dollar
mentions.falsify_match: The operation is shown to be about defending the dollar.

mentions.claim_text: A great liberty of the spirit throughout Venezuela, with a proxy government bringing financial freedom and stability.
mentions.quote: I'm going to bring a great liberty of my spirit throughout all of Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Political and economic opening in Venezuela with a religious revival.

mentions.claim_text: He describes holding the images from visions inside him and carrying them.
mentions.quote: I see it inside. I grab hold of it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a description of how he receives.

mentions.claim_text: They put a location on the big screen and intercede over it as though walking through it together.
mentions.quote: we're walking the mall toget
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a method of interceding.

mentions.claim_text: Throughout New York the lights are off in the great buildings and it is dark.
mentions.quote: I see the lights off in the great buildings above
mentions.falsify_match: A city-wide New York blackout.

mentions.claim_text: A big long medical boat parked outside New York, seen repeatedly.
mentions.quote: THERE'S A MEDICAL BOAT, A BIG LONG MEDICAL BOAT
mentions.falsify_match: A hospital ship deployed to New York.

mentions.claim_text: They try to inflict a shot, and the moment people took it they became very sick with boils and massive pus pockets.
mentions.quote: there were boils, these massive pus pockets
mentions.falsify_match: An injection campaign followed by an outbreak of skin lesions.

mentions.claim_text: A fog over New York City, the electric grid named, and an enormous Navy medical boat parked outside.
mentions.quote: There was a fog all in New York City
mentions.falsify_match: A New York emergency combining a grid failure with a naval medical deployment.

mentions.claim_text: The cold because there was no electricity, over multiple days, with dark wood heard.
mentions.quote: because there was no electricity
mentions.falsify_match: A multi-day winter outage.

mentions.claim_text: No power from Toronto all the way down to Miami, with the whole east coast out.
mentions.quote: there was no power from uh Toronto all the way down to Miami
mentions.falsify_match: An outage spanning the eastern seaboard.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why the word dogwood came and where it resonates, writing it down publicly as they work.
mentions.quote: I saw the dogwood, but I'm want to know why dogwood
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a word with no referent given.

mentions.claim_text: The big boat in the water at New York, with New Jersey named, alongside the space race.
mentions.quote: that big boat out in the water in New York
mentions.falsify_match: A medical ship deployment covering New York and New Jersey.

mentions.claim_text: Damascus becomes a ruinous heap because of what they bring out of it, worse than the seventh, as they regroup and devise a plan.
mentions.quote: They bring it out of Damascus
mentions.falsify_match: Damascus destroyed following a weapon originating there.

mentions.claim_text: Twenty four billion dollars went to a slush fund for corruption, of a total he puts at more than seventy seven billion.
mentions.quote: twenty-four billion of it went to a slush fund
mentions.falsify_match: Misappropriation on that scale is documented.

mentions.claim_text: The man with cocaine in his nose, shown to have been in the meeting.
mentions.quote: There's the cocaine in his nose
mentions.falsify_match: Substance use by the named leader becomes established.

mentions.claim_text: A group of older businessmen in suits behind them pushing to keep the war going, with black swan events coming.
mentions.quote: a group of businessmen with suits, older men
mentions.falsify_match: Commercial interests shown driving the continuation of the war.

mentions.claim_text: He says he called the Venezuelan escalation before Trump was even president, saying the leader would become the new Gaddafi or Saddam.
mentions.quote: he will become the new Gaddafi Saddam Hussein
mentions.falsify_match: A prior corpus passage predating the election, plus the leader's removal.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior passage, or he is not removed.

mentions.claim_text: They keep saying they must destroy the eagle but cannot attack from outside, so they will come in, a long plotted plan.
mentions.quote: We can't attack them from outside. We will come in
mentions.falsify_match: An attack executed from within by people already inside.

mentions.claim_text: Something shrunk with a clamp around it, identified as the NSA, with the instruction to keep praying to cut the head off the snake and cut the supply.
mentions.quote: KEEP PRAYING TO CUT THE HEAD OFF OF THIS SNAKE
mentions.falsify_match: A network disrupted at its command level, cutting its supply.

mentions.claim_text: It was kinked off in New York where the computers and over a hundred thousand SIM cards were found, but communication continues, and it ran from Boston.
mentions.quote: The SIM cards, over 100,000 SIM cards
mentions.falsify_match: Further SIM farms found beyond the New York seizure.

mentions.claim_text: It is more than back room chat, using burner phones and sophisticated methods, and it ran to Honolulu.
mentions.quote: it went clear to Honolulu, Hawaii
mentions.falsify_match: A network node found in Hawaii.

mentions.claim_text: The word Mecca heard repeatedly in tongues and in English, which he says has to do with the Muslims.
mentions.quote: Hear the word Mecca
mentions.falsify_match: A major event at or concerning Mecca.

mentions.claim_text: Much more migration, with people leaving New York, Chicago, Pennsylvania and Philadelphia.
mentions.quote: They'll be leaving Chicago. They'll be leaving Pennsylvania
mentions.falsify_match: Net outmigration from those cities accelerates.

mentions.claim_text: Places of the world become much more different from one another, Europe more different than America, and Canada different despite being close.
mentions.quote: Europe will be much more different than America
mentions.falsify_match: A visible divergence between those societies.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no measure given.

mentions.claim_text: Even with Trump at the helm there is a great shaking in the nation and civil unrest.
mentions.quote: a great shaking in your nation. Civil unrest
mentions.falsify_match: Major civil unrest in the United States.

mentions.claim_text: Someone connected with crypto and money is going to be pardoned, which he says is either coming or has happened.
mentions.quote: Somebody's going to get pardoned
mentions.falsify_match: A pardon for a figure in the crypto industry.

mentions.claim_text: A plumb line seen, explained on air as the vertical measure that keeps a wall straight.
mentions.quote: And a plumb line
mentions.falsify_match: A new standard set that other prices are measured against.

mentions.claim_text: Banks seen in tiers, with Chase and Bank of America much larger than the others, and something happening when the plumb line is set.
mentions.quote: Chase Bank and Bank of America were a lot bigger
mentions.falsify_match: The largest banks move first on the new standard.

mentions.claim_text: Japan's economy and currency in trouble, seen while praying.
mentions.quote: Japan's economy is in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: A Japanese currency or debt crisis.

mentions.claim_text: The wealth transfer will not be what you thought; ride the wave, then Trump pops it and brings in CBDCs.
mentions.quote: I see Trump he pops it and then brings in CBDCs
mentions.falsify_match: A central bank digital currency introduced after a market break.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had not planned to make a video and has been in a river of prayer all day.
mentions.quote: I was not going to do a video cuz I've been praying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a preamble.

mentions.claim_text: Hawaii and Honolulu, with a major plan being plotted on the strip by a man who does not want to die.
mentions.quote: I see on the strip a major plan is being plotted
mentions.falsify_match: A plot in Honolulu uncovered or executed.

mentions.claim_text: A man from Afghanistan planned to attack people in Fort Worth, Texas that day but talked too much, which he credits to prayer for confusion in the enemy's camp.
mentions.quote: the people in Fort Worth, Texas today, but he didn't do it
mentions.falsify_match: A foiled plot in Fort Worth reported that day.

mentions.claim_text: Many in Canada will feel they are already in tribulation, with the olives on the olive press.
mentions.quote: Many of you in Canada will feel like you're already in tribulation
mentions.falsify_match: Conditions in Canada severe enough for that description.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: a feeling, not a measure.

mentions.claim_text: A joke about going into the White House and them not knowing what to do with him.
mentions.quote: I'll go into that White House
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an aside.
